meta.name: Canvas FX — Extended Pack
meta.description: Effects for the Canvas FX editor. Load via 'Load pack' or drop on the stage. Re-loading replaces effects with the same id, so you can edit this file and reload it.

notes: Params are available by their key. Colour params also expose key_r, key_g, key_b (0-255).
No && or ||; use nested if or multiply conditions. One declaration per 'let'.
Effects reference a category by id; categories are defined in the top-level 'categories' array (order = display order).

categories.label: Color & Tone
categories.description: Grading, tinting, palette mapping and tonal looks.

categories.label: Cinematic
categories.description: Film-style grades, grain, bars and vignettes.

categories.label: Light & Glow
categories.description: Bloom, rays, flares and light leaks.

categories.label: Lens & Optics
categories.description: Chromatic aberration, lens warp, sharpening and clarity.

categories.label: Blur & Focus
categories.description: Gaussian-style, directional, radial and tilt-shift blurs.

categories.label: Warp & Distort
categories.description: Geometry bending: swirls, mirrors, tunnels and melts.

categories.label: Motion & Animated
categories.description: Time-driven effects that move, pulse or shake.

categories.label: Glitch
categories.description: Digital corruption, tearing and channel breakup.

categories.label: Retro & Analog
categories.description: VHS, CRT, handheld and vintage film looks.

categories.label: Stylize & Art
categories.description: Posterise, outlines, sketches and pop-art treatments.

categories.label: Pixel & Mosaic
categories.description: Grids, dots, LEDs and tile-based looks.

categories.label: Vision & Sensors
categories.description: Thermal, night-vision, X-ray and surveillance views.

categories.label: Atmosphere
categories.description: Weather and ambient overlays: snow, rain, fog, stars.

effects.name: Chromatic Split
effects.description: Pulls red and blue channels apart horizontally.

effects.name: Scanlines
effects.description: Darkens every Nth row.

source: return rgb(src.r * k, src.g * k, src.b * k);

effects.name: Vignette
effects.description: Radial darkening from the centre.

source: let d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) / softness;
return rgb(src.r * k, src.g * k, src.b * k);

effects.name: Pixelate
effects.description: Quantises sample coordinates to a grid.

source: let sx = floor(x / size) * size + size * 0.5;
let sy = floor(y / size) * size + size * 0.5;

effects.name: Posterize
effects.description: Snaps each channel to N levels.

source: return rgb(round(src.r / st) * st, round(src.g / st) * st, round(src.b / st) * st);

effects.name: Bloom
effects.description: Soft glow that bleeds from bright regions (12-tap, two rings).

source: let s = sample(x + cos(ang) * rr, y + sin(ang) * rr);
return rgb(c.r + sr * k, c.g + sg * k, c.b + sb * k);

effects.name: Hue Rotate
effects.description: Rotates hue via an RGB rotation matrix.

effects.name: Sharpen
effects.description: 3×3 unsharp mask.

source: return rgb(c.r + (c.r - (l.r + r.r + t.r + b.r) / 4) * amount,

effects.name: Radial Chroma
effects.description: Channel separation that grows toward the frame edges, like cheap lens fringing.

source: let d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
let r = sample(x + nx * o, y + ny * o);
let b = sample(x - nx * o, y - ny * o);

effects.name: Wave Warp
effects.description: Animated sine displacement on both axes.

source: let ox = sin(y / wavelength * 2 * pi + time * speed) * amplitude;
let oy = sin(x / wavelength * 2 * pi + time * speed) * vertical;

effects.name: Ripple
effects.description: Concentric water ripples radiating from a point.

source: let d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
let k = sin(d / wavelength * 2 * pi - time * speed) * amplitude * fall;
return sample(x + dx / (d + 0.001) * k, y + dy / (d + 0.001) * k);

effects.name: Swirl
effects.description: Twirls the image around the centre, optionally pulsing.

source: let d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
let a = t * t * (angle * pi / 180 + sin(time * spin) * pi);
return sample(w * 0.5 + dx * ca - dy * sa, h * 0.5 + dx * sa + dy * ca);

effects.name: Lens Distortion
effects.description: Barrel (positive) or pincushion (negative) warp.

source: let f = 1 + strength * (dx * dx + dy * dy);
return sample(w * 0.5 + dx * f * w * 0.5, h * 0.5 + dy * f * h * 0.5);

effects.name: Heat Haze
effects.description: Shimmering hot-air refraction.

source: let dx = sin(y * frequency * 2 + time * speed) * sin(x * frequency + time * speed * 0.7) * amplitude;
let dy = cos(x * frequency * 1.7 + time * speed * 1.3) * amplitude * 0.5;

effects.name: Kaleidoscope
effects.description: Mirrored polar wedges around the centre.

source: let d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
let ang = atan2(dy, dx) + rotation * pi / 180 + time * spin;
return sample(w * 0.5 + cos(a2) * d, h * 0.5 + sin(a2) * d);

effects.name: Mirror
effects.description: Reflects one half of the frame onto the other.

source: if (mode == 0) { return sample(x > w * 0.5 ? w - x : x, y); }
if (mode == 1) { return sample(x < w * 0.5 ? w - x : x, y); }
if (mode == 2) { return sample(x, y > h * 0.5 ? h - y : y); }
return sample(x, y < h * 0.5 ? h - y : y);

effects.name: Tile
effects.description: Repeats the frame in a grid.

source: return sample(mod(x * count, w), mod(y * count, h));

effects.name: Pulse Zoom
effects.description: Beat-style zoom kick that decays between pulses.

source: let z = 1 - amount * pow(1 - mod(time * speed, 1), punch);
return sample(w * 0.5 + (x - w * 0.5) * z, h * 0.5 + (y - h * 0.5) * z);

effects.name: Camera Shake
effects.description: Handheld jitter.

effects.name: Glitch Blocks
effects.description: Random horizontal slices tear sideways with RGB splitting.

source: let r = sample(x + shift + sp, y);
let b = sample(x + shift - sp, y);

effects.name: VHS Tape
effects.description: Wobble, colour bleed, tracking bar and tape noise.

source: let wob = sin(y * 0.05 + time * 6) * jitter + sin(y * 0.9 + time * 31) * jitter * 0.35 + bandv * jitter * 6;

effects.name: CRT Monitor
effects.description: Curved glass, scanlines, RGB phosphor mask and edge falloff.

source: let ux = nx * (1 + ny * ny * curve);
let uy = ny * (1 + nx * nx * curve);
let vig = 1 - clamp(sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny) - 0.7, 0, 1) * 0.5;
return rgb(c.r * k * mr, c.g * k * mg, c.b * k * mb);

effects.name: Scan Sweep
effects.description: A bright bar sweeping down the frame.

source: let g = clamp(1 - abs(v - pos) / width, 0, 1);
return rgb(c.r + k, c.g + k, c.b + k);

effects.name: Flicker
effects.description: Random per-step brightness flutter, like a failing bulb or old projector.

source: return rgb(c.r * k, c.g * k, c.b * k);

effects.name: Film Grain
effects.description: Animated luminance noise, strongest in the mid-tones.

source: return rgb(c.r + k, c.g + k, c.b + k);

effects.name: Color Grade
effects.description: Brightness, contrast, saturation, gamma and temperature in one pass.

effects.name: Teal & Orange
effects.description: Blockbuster split-tone: cool shadows, warm highlights.

effects.name: Sepia
effects.description: Warm vintage tone.

source: return rgb(lerp(c.r, sr, amount), lerp(c.g, sg, amount), lerp(c.b, sb, amount));

effects.name: Invert
effects.description: Negative image.

source: return rgb(lerp(c.r, 255 - c.r, amount), lerp(c.g, 255 - c.g, amount), lerp(c.b, 255 - c.b, amount));

effects.name: Solarize
effects.description: Inverts everything brighter than the threshold.

source: let r = c.r > lim ? 255 - c.r : c.r;
let g = c.g > lim ? 255 - c.g : c.g;
let b = c.b > lim ? 255 - c.b : c.b;

effects.name: Channel Swap
effects.description: Reorders the RGB channels.

effects.name: Hue Cycle
effects.description: Continuously rotates hue over time.

effects.name: Duotone
effects.description: Maps luminance onto a two-colour gradient.

source: return rgb(lerp(shadow_r, light_r, t), lerp(shadow_g, light_g, t), lerp(shadow_b, light_b, t));

effects.name: Threshold
effects.description: Hard black/white (or any two colours) split by brightness.

source: let t = smoothstep(level - soft, level + soft, lum);
return rgb(lerp(dark_r, bright_r, t), lerp(dark_g, bright_g, t), lerp(dark_b, bright_b, t));

effects.name: Thermal Camera
effects.description: Heat-map palette driven by brightness.

effects.name: Night Vision
effects.description: Green phosphor amplification with noise and vignette.

source: let vig = 1 - clamp(sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) * 1.6 - 0.35, 0, 1) * 0.8;

effects.name: Edge Detect
effects.description: Sobel outlines in any colour, optionally over the source.

source: let gx = ltr + 2 * lrr + lbr - ltl - 2 * lll - lbl;
let gy = lbl + 2 * lbb + lbr - ltl - 2 * ltt - ltr;
let mag = clamp(sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy) * strength - threshold, 0, 1);
return rgb(c.r * keep + color_r * mag, c.g * keep + color_g * mag, c.b * keep + color_b * mag);

effects.name: Emboss
effects.description: Relief shading from a diagonal gradient.

source: let k = 128 + ((a.r - b.r) + (a.g - b.g) + (a.b - b.b)) / 3 * strength;
return rgb(lerp(k, c.r, tint), lerp(k, c.g, tint), lerp(k, c.b, tint));

effects.name: Halftone
effects.description: Print-style dot screen.

source: let gx = floor(x / size) * size + size * 0.5;
let gy = floor(y / size) * size + size * 0.5;
let cov = clamp(rad - sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + 0.5, 0, 1);
return rgb(lerp(paper, lerp(ink, c.r, color), cov),

effects.name: Ordered Dither
effects.description: 4×4 Bayer-matrix dithering with adjustable palette depth.

source: let c = sample(px * pxsize + pxsize * 0.5, py * pxsize + pxsize * 0.5);
return rgb(round((c.r + t * st * spread) / st) * st,
round((c.g + t * st * spread) / st) * st,
round((c.b + t * st * spread) / st) * st);

effects.name: Crosshatch
effects.description: Pen-and-ink hatching; darker areas get more line layers.

source: if (lum < 0.4) { ink = ink + (mod(x + y + spacing * 0.5, spacing) < 1 ? 1 : 0); }
if (lum < 0.22) { ink = ink + (mod(x - y + spacing * 0.5, spacing) < 1 ? 1 : 0); }

effects.name: Soft Blur
effects.description: 13-tap disc blur.

source: let s = sample(x + cos(ang) * rr, y + sin(ang) * rr);

effects.name: Motion Blur
effects.description: Directional smear.

source: let s = sample(x + dx * t, y + dy * t);

effects.name: Zoom Blur
effects.description: Radial speed-lines blur toward a focal point.

source: let s = sample(ox + (x - ox) * k, oy + (y - oy) * k);

effects.name: Tilt-Shift
effects.description: Miniature-model look: sharp band, blurred above and below.

source: let amt = clamp((abs(v - focus) - band) / 0.25, 0, 1) * maxBlur;
let s = sample(x + i * amt, y + j * amt);

effects.name: Anamorphic Streak
effects.description: Horizontal blue lens streaks from bright highlights.

source: let s = sample(x + i * reach / 5, y);
return rgb(c.r + k * color_r, c.g + k * color_g, c.b + k * color_b);

effects.name: Light Leak
effects.description: Drifting screen-blended colour wash, like a leaky film back.

source: let gl = clamp(1 - sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) * 1.4, 0, 1);

effects.name: Spotlight
effects.description: A roaming pool of light with the rest of the frame dimmed.

source: let lit = 1 - smoothstep(radius, radius + softness, sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy));
return rgb(c.r * k, c.g * k, c.b * k);

effects.name: Letterbox
effects.description: Black cinema bars top and bottom.

effects.name: Magnifier
effects.description: A roaming lens that magnifies a circle of the frame.

source: let d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
let kk = lerp(1 / zoom, 1, q * q);
return sample(cxp + dx * kk, cyp + dy * kk);

effects.name: Rotate & Zoom
effects.description: Rotates and scales the whole frame, optionally spinning.

source: return sample(w * 0.5 + (dx * cos(a) - dy * sin(a)) / zoom, h * 0.5 + (dx * sin(a) + dy * cos(a)) / zoom);

effects.name: Tunnel
effects.description: Polar remap: the frame wraps into an endless tunnel.

source: let d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
let sx = mod((ang * turns + time * spin) * w, w);
let sy = mod((depth / (d + 0.08) + time * speed) * h * 0.25, h);

effects.name: Shear
effects.description: Skews the frame horizontally and/or vertically.

source: return sample(x + (y - h * 0.5) * amount, y + (x - w * 0.5) * vertical);

effects.name: Melt
effects.description: Pixel columns drip downward at different rates.

source: let drip = (0.15 + f * 0.85) * amount * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(time * speed + f * 6.28));

effects.name: RGB Shift
effects.description: Splits the channels along any angle; can rotate over time.

source: let r = sample(x + dx, y + dy);
let b = sample(x - dx, y - dy);

effects.name: Block Shuffle
effects.description: Random rectangular blocks jump out of place, datamosh-style.

source: return sample(x + (f2 * 2 - 1) * size * 2 * hit, y + (f3 * 2 - 1) * size * hit);

effects.name: Signal Tear
effects.description: A rolling band that tears sideways with colour fringing.

source: let k = d < band ? 1 - d / band : 0;
let r = sample(x + off + k * split, y);
let b = sample(x + off - k * split, y);

effects.name: TV Static
effects.description: Analogue snow with occasional bright line flashes.

source: let n = sin(floor(x / size) * 12.9898 + floor(y / size) * 78.233 + time * 113.7) * 43758.5453;
return rgb(lerp(c.r, f * 255, m), lerp(c.g, f * 255, m), lerp(c.b, f * 255, m));

effects.name: Ghosting
effects.description: Faint displaced echoes of the image, like a bad antenna.

source: let g1 = sample(x + cos(a) * d, y + sin(a) * d);
let g2 = sample(x - cos(a) * d * 0.6, y - sin(a) * d * 0.6);
return rgb(lerp(c.r, (g1.r + g2.r) * 0.5, amount), lerp(c.g, (g1.g + g2.g) * 0.5, amount), lerp(c.b, (g1.b + g2.b) * 0.5, amount));

effects.name: Handheld LCD
effects.description: Four-shade green palette with Bayer dithering.

source: let c = sample(px * pxsize + pxsize * 0.5, py * pxsize + pxsize * 0.5);

effects.name: CGA Palette
effects.description: Four-colour 1980s PC graphics with ordered dither.

source: let c = sample(px * pxsize + pxsize * 0.5, py * pxsize + pxsize * 0.5);

effects.name: Phosphor Terminal
effects.description: Single-colour monochrome monitor with scanlines and flicker.

source: let k = clamp(pow(lum, 0.8) * gain, 0, 1.4) * sl * fl;
return rgb(color_r * k, color_g * k, color_b * k);

effects.name: Faded Film
effects.description: Lifted blacks, washed colours and a hint of teal in the shadows.

source: return rgb(k + r * (1 - lift) + 6, k + g * (1 - lift), k + b * (1 - lift) + (1 - lum / 255) * 16 * fade);

effects.name: Old Film
effects.description: Sepia stock with scratches, dust, gate jitter, flicker and grain.

source: let vig = 1 - clamp(sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) * 1.5 - 0.3, 0, 1) * 0.7;
return rgb(lerp(lum * 1.08 * k + grn, 235, ink), lerp(lum * 0.94 * k + grn, 225, ink), lerp(lum * 0.74 * k + grn, 200, ink));

effects.name: Black & White
effects.description: Channel-mixer monochrome, like coloured filters on B&W film.

source: let g = (c.r * wr + c.g * wg + c.b * wb - 128) * contrast + 128;
return rgb(lerp(c.r, g, amount), lerp(c.g, g, amount), lerp(c.b, g, amount));

effects.name: Tritone
effects.description: Three-stop gradient map: shadows, mid-tones, highlights.

source: return rgb(t < 0.5 ? lerp(shadow_r, mid_r, t * 2) : lerp(mid_r, high_r, (t - 0.5) * 2),
t < 0.5 ? lerp(shadow_g, mid_g, t * 2) : lerp(mid_g, high_g, (t - 0.5) * 2),
t < 0.5 ? lerp(shadow_b, mid_b, t * 2) : lerp(mid_b, high_b, (t - 0.5) * 2));

effects.name: Bleach Bypass
effects.description: Gritty, desaturated, high-contrast film-lab look.

source: return rgb((lerp(c.r, orr, amount) - 128) * contrast + 128, (lerp(c.g, og, amount) - 128) * contrast + 128, (lerp(c.b, ob, amount) - 128) * contrast + 128);

effects.name: Color Pop
effects.description: Keeps one hue in colour and turns everything else grey.

source: let sat = clamp((max(c.r, max(c.g, c.b)) - min(c.r, min(c.g, c.b))) / 40, 0, 1);
let keep = (1 - smoothstep(range, range + soft, dh)) * sat;
return rgb(lerp(lum, c.r, keep), lerp(lum, c.g, keep), lerp(lum, c.b, keep));

effects.name: Cross Process
effects.description: Slide-film-in-negative-chemistry colour shift.

source: return rgb(lerp(c.r, r, amount), lerp(c.g, g, amount), lerp(c.b, b, amount));

effects.name: Day for Night
effects.description: Turns daylight footage into moonlit blue.

source: return rgb((lum + (c.r - lum) * 0.6) * k * 0.7, (lum + (c.g - lum) * 0.6) * k * 0.9, (lum + (c.b - lum) * 0.6) * k * 1.15 + darkness * 25);

effects.name: Golden Hour
effects.description: Warm low-sun grade with a glowing light source.

source: let gl = clamp(1 - sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) * 1.2, 0, 1);
return rgb(r + gl * 255, g + gl * 170, b + gl * 70);

effects.name: Cartoon
effects.description: Flat posterised colour with inked outlines.

source: let gx = (r2.r + r2.g + r2.b - l.r - l.g - l.b) / 765;
let gy = (b.r + b.g + b.b - t.r - t.g - t.b) / 765;
let k = 1 - clamp(sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy) * edge * 3, 0, 1);
return rgb(round(c.r / st) * st * k, round(c.g / st) * st * k, round(c.b / st) * st * k);

effects.name: Pencil Sketch
effects.description: Graphite line drawing on paper, optionally tinted by the source.

source: let s = sample(x + cos(ang) * radius, y + sin(ang) * radius);
return rgb(lerp(k, c.r * k / 255, color), lerp(k, c.g * k / 255, color), lerp(k, c.b * k / 255, color));

effects.name: Pop Art
effects.description: Four flat colours by brightness band, Warhol-style.

effects.name: Spin Blur
effects.description: Rotational blur around a pivot.

source: let s = sample(ox + dx * cos(a) - dy * sin(a), oy + dx * sin(a) + dy * cos(a));

effects.name: Frosted Glass
effects.description: Per-pixel scatter, like looking through textured glass.

effects.name: Sun Rays
effects.description: God-rays streaming from a light source toward the viewer.

source: let s = sample(x + (ox - x) * k, y + (oy - y) * k);
let wgt = clamp((lm - threshold) / (1 - threshold), 0, 1) * (1 - i / 12);
return rgb(c.r + sr * q, c.g + sg * q, c.b + sb * q);

effects.name: Lens Flare
effects.description: Ghost reflections of bright areas mirrored through the lens centre.

source: let wgt = clamp((lm - threshold) / (1 - threshold), 0, 1) / (1 + i * 0.6);
return rgb(c.r + sr * strength * color_r / 255, c.g + sg * strength * color_g / 255, c.b + sb * strength * color_b / 255);

effects.name: Halation
effects.description: Red-orange glow bleeding around highlights, like film emulsion.

source: let s = sample(x + cos(ang) * rr, y + sin(ang) * rr);
return rgb(c.r + k * color_r, c.g + k * color_g, c.b + k * color_b);

effects.name: Soft Focus
effects.description: Dreamy diffusion glow over the whole image.

source: let s = sample(x + cos(ang) * rr, y + sin(ang) * rr);
return rgb(lerp(c.r, br, amount) + br * glow * 0.4, lerp(c.g, bg, amount) + bg * glow * 0.4, lerp(c.b, bb, amount) + bb * glow * 0.4);

effects.name: Clarity
effects.description: Local-contrast boost that adds punch without crunching shadows.

source: let s = sample(x + cos(ang) * rr, y + sin(ang) * rr);
return rgb(c.r + (c.r - sr / 12) * amount, c.g + (c.g - sg / 12) * amount, c.b + (c.b - sb / 12) * amount);

effects.name: Snowfall
effects.description: Three parallax layers of drifting snowflakes.

source: let fy = y - time * speed * cs * (1 + i * 0.4);
let fx2 = (gx + 0.2 + f2 * 0.6) * cs + sin(time + f * 6.28) * cs * 0.3;
let d = sqrt((x - fx2) * (x - fx2) + (fy - fy2) * (fy - fy2));
let flake = f > 1 - density ? clamp(cs * 0.22 - d + 0.5, 0, 1) : 0;
return rgb(lerp(c.r, 255, k), lerp(c.g, 255, k), lerp(c.b, 255, k));

effects.name: Rain
effects.description: Slanted rain streaks in two depth layers.

source: let yy = mod(time * spd - y + f * h, h);
let ln = yy < h * streak ? 1 - yy / (h * streak) : 0;
k = k + ln * act * clamp(1.2 - dx, 0, 1);
return rgb(lerp(c.r, 210, k), lerp(c.g, 225, k), lerp(c.b, 255, k));

effects.name: Fog
effects.description: Drifting volumetric haze, thicker toward the bottom.

source: return rgb(lerp(c.r, color_r, k), lerp(c.g, color_g, k), lerp(c.b, color_b, k));

effects.name: Twinkling Stars
effects.description: Procedural stars that twinkle over the frame.

source: let d = sqrt((x - sx) * (x - sx) + (y - sy) * (y - sy));
let star = f1 > 1 - density ? clamp(size * 0.14 - d + 0.5, 0, 1) * tw : 0;
return rgb(c.r + star * color_r, c.g + star * color_g, c.b + star * color_b);

effects.name: X-Ray
effects.description: Inverted greyscale with a cool medical tint and edge boost.

source: let edge = (abs(r.r - l.r) + abs(b.g - t.g)) * boost;
let inv = clamp((255 - lum - 128) * contrast + 128 + edge, 0, 255);

effects.name: Blueprint
effects.description: White technical line-work on a drafting-blue grid.

source: let gx = (r.r + r.g + r.b - l.r - l.g - l.b) / 765;
let gy = (b.r + b.g + b.b - t.r - t.g - t.b) / 765;
let mag = clamp(sqrt(gx * gx + gy * gy) * strength * 3, 0, 1);
let grid = mod(x, gridsize) < 1 ? 1 : mod(y, gridsize) < 1 ? 1 : 0;
return rgb(lerp(bg_r, line_r, k), lerp(bg_g, line_g, k), lerp(bg_b, line_b, k));

effects.name: Security Cam
effects.description: Grainy, low-contrast CCTV feed with a blinking REC light.

source: let vig = 1 - clamp(sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) * 1.5 - 0.3, 0, 1) * 0.6;
let g = clamp((lum - 128) * 0.9 + 128 + nz, 0, 255) * vig * sl;
if (sqrt(rx * rx + ry * ry) < 7) { return rgb(235, 40, 40); }

effects.name: LED Matrix
effects.description: Round glowing LEDs on a black panel.

source: let cxp = floor(x / cell) * cell + cell * 0.5;
let cyp = floor(y / cell) * cell + cell * 0.5;
let d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
return rgb(c.r * k, c.g * k, c.b * k);

effects.name: Bevel Mosaic
effects.description: Square tiles with lit top-left and shaded bottom-right bevels.

source: let c = sample(cx0 * size + size * 0.5, cy0 * size + size * 0.5);
let sh = (ly < border ? 0.3 : 0) + (lx < border ? 0.2 : 0) - (ly > 1 - border ? 0.3 : 0) - (lx > 1 - border ? 0.2 : 0);
return rgb(c.r * k, c.g * k, c.b * k);
